Usage: input mouse click [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Click (or tap) at a position: press, keep it pressed for --hold-duration seconds, and release. Simulates the Input System Mouse device in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.inputsystem. Specify either --x and --y, or --instance-id (requires com.unity.ugui).

Options:
  --x <float?>                X coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Note: capture_game_view images are at the Game View resolution with a top-left origin, so a pixel (px, py) in the image corresponds to x = px, y = imageHeight - py. (Default: null)
  --y <float?>                Y coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.height space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases upward. This is the inverse of typical image coordinates where Y increases downward. (Default: null)
  --instance-id <int?>        instanceId of the UI GameObject. Its center is used. (Default: null)
  --button <string>           Mouse button: "left" (default), "right", or "middle". (Default: @"left")
  --hold-duration <float?>    Seconds to keep the button pressed before releasing it, e.g. for a long press (default 0: release in the next frame). (Default: null)

Options:
  --x <float?>                X coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Usage: timeline track add [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Add a track to a TimelineAsset. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

Arguments:
  [0] <int>       The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component.
  [1] <string>    Fully qualified type name of the track (e.g. UnityEngine.Timeline.AnimationTrack).

Options:
  --track-name <string>    Optional name for the new track. (Default: @"")

Usage: timeline track list [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Get the tracks and clips of a Timeline. Specify either instanceId or assetPath. Requires com.unity.timeline.

Options:
  --instance-id <int>       The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component. 0 to use assetPath instead. (Default: 0)
  --asset-path <string?>    Asset path of the TimelineAsset (e.g. "Assets/Timelines/MyTimeline.playable"). Used when instanceId is 0. (Default: null)

result.stdout:
Usage: timeline track property set [arguments...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Set a serialized property on a Timeline track. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

Arguments:
  [0] <int>       The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component.
  [1] <int>       The index of the track (0-based).
  [2] <string>    The serialized property path (e.g. "m_Muted", "m_TrackOffset").
  [3] <string>    The new value as a string. Object references accept an asset path, an asset GUID, an instanceId, or "null".
